items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: That's the reason why you get a lot of guys like Tim.

ctx.x: We're talking about not running into the trombone part and so on.

Yeah, I try to keep from running the trombone part. That's the reason why you get a lot of guys like Tim. People would ask you, would you think he would fit in the Dixieland band? Or will this guy fit in the Dixieland band? A lot of times, this guy won't fit in the Dixieland band because what the trumpet player is doing, he's trying to play the same thing with clarinet is playing. You know, everybody is running. But when you get a good trumpet player, he still can go his way but play the melody. You know, play…
As far as that was concerned, I had a question to ask you. When the trumpet is playing, more or less sticking straight to the melody, do you try to make your little runs more in the harmony part?
